model_gaps: /livewire/message/<component> is not an entry point in the model
No invariant for BW activation, partnerships, biz attribution, room access or the review circuit
Invariant 7 has no URL-scheme clause, undercounts |safe and ignores private Jinja environments and Markup
CSP is not modelled as a control, though it decides the impact of every XSS
CSRF rests on SameSite=Lax alone and has no trust-boundary row
Member passwords are missing from Credentials; cleartext sign-up passwords reported in ses_session._data (unverified)
Deployment section is stale: production runs on Piku; Dramatiq uses Postgres, not Redis; search is not Typesense; /queue has no routes
CI: no invariant on trusted code and credentials; no permissions block in tracked workflows
/search, /system/*, /kyc/check_mail, /kyc/done, /sandbox and /page, API docs routes are not listed
Platform mail as an abuse channel, SSRF via Organisation.site_url and third-party runtime scripts are not modelled
/system/boot was accepted on 2026-09-17 but is not in Out of scope

findings.title: Anonymous format-string injection in the livewire route discloses app config, process environment and member columns
findings.adversary: An anonymous visitor
findings.evidence: POST /livewire/message/<component> -> pywire/_routes.py:16 app-level route with no auth -> _routes.py:26 _restore(attacker dict) -> _components.py:95 setattr with no allowlist, so instance _template is attacker-controlled -> _routes.py:45 render -> _components.py:110 self._template.format(self=self, ctx=ctx) -> returned in effects.html. Attribute traversal in the format string reaches app config, os.environ and member columns.

findings.title: The livewire route serves member, organisation and group directories to anonymous visitors

findings.evidence: POST /livewire/message/members-list -> _routes.py:24 registry lookup -> members_list.py:38 context -> :51 public_member_filters only -> members_list.j2:154-172 renders name, photo, function, organisation. The swork gate (swork/__init__.py:24) does not apply through this app-level route.

findings.title: SECRET_KEY committed in a public repository, in the section production resolves to
findings.evidence: SECRET_KEY under [development], in git history -> src/app/flask/config.py Dynaconf with environments=True and no ENV_FOR_DYNACONF resolves to [development] -> Flask session signer and Flask-Security serializers. Sessions are client-side signed cookies (extensions.py:99 Flask-Session commented out). Partial stop: _user_loader needs a uuid4 fs_uniquifier (auth.py:231). The key still forges other session values, including session['bw_id'] (bw_activation/user_utils.py:479). A FLASK_SECRET_KEY override in production cannot be ruled out from the repo.

findings.title: Stored XSS against the admin: admin tables render member text with autoescape off
findings.adversary: An anonymous visitor (sign-up); a signed-in member through /kyc/modify
findings.evidence: POST /kyc/wizard/<profile_id> -> dynform.py:349-352 first_name/last_name Length(max=80) only -> kyc/views.py:197-215, :424, :634, :521-522 User(first_name, last_name) -> models/auth.py:144-145 String(64) -> admin opens /admin/new_users (views/users.py:50-58) -> views/_new_users.py:66 full_name -> table.py:83 private Environment with select_autoescape() whose default extensions exclude .j2, so 'table.html.j2' has autoescape off -> table.py:86-91 render_cell plain str -> table.html.j2:50 -> table.py:112 Markup -> generic_table.j2:4. CSP allows inline script and unpkg (etc/settings.toml:125-142). In the admin session a script could use views/show_user.py:209-213 grant_admin and views/db_export.py:85. Other sources: clone names (views/_modif_users.py:68), org and BW names (views/_orgs.py:125-126), group names (views/_groups.py:41), content titles (views/_contents.py:43-44).

findings.title: Reflected XSS in the admin table search box via the search parameter
